name: Muse Code
description: A terminal-based AI coding agent from Meta Superintelligence Labs, designed for long-horizon software engineering tasks. Built on the Muse Spark 1.2 model with 1M-token context, explicit reasoning mode, and multi-agentic workflows for complex software development. Features persistent background agents, project memory with restart-safe logging, and can work autonomously for up to 24 hours on large codebases.
